command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
MODEL=r1041_e82_400bps_hac_v6.0.0

echo "== the model is PINNED, not auto-resolved =="
# medaka can infer a model from basecaller tags in the input, but this recipe states it
# explicitly for the same reason it pins image digests: the run must not depend on metadata
# that staging could strip. The model must be one the IMAGE carries -- medaka 2.2.2 bundles
# four, so nothing is fetched at run time.
medaka --version
medaka tools list_models 2>&1 | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^ *//' | grep -c . > /dev/null
medaka tools list_models 2>&1 | grep -q "$MODEL" || { echo "model $MODEL not in this image"; medaka tools list_models 2>&1 | head -5; exit 1; }
echo "model_pinned\t$MODEL (bundled, no download)"

echo "== medaka consensus from the same draft and the same reads racon saw =="
T0=$(date +%s)
medaka_consensus -i reads.fastq -d draft.fa -o med -t 2 -m "$MODEL" > medaka.log 2>&1
RC=$?; T1=$(date +%s)
echo "medaka_rc\t$RC"
test "$RC" = "0" || { tail -30 medaka.log; exit 1; }
cp med/consensus.fasta polished-medaka.fa
echo "medaka_wall_s\t$(( T1 - T0 ))"

echo "== score ALL THREE against the depositors' reference, by exact edit distance =="
# python-edlib ships in this image, so the distance is exact Levenshtein rather than a
# heuristic from an aligner's NM tag.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' | tee score.tsv
import edlib, math, sys

def seq(p):
    s = []
    for line in open(p):
        if not line.startswith(">"):
            s.append(line.strip())
    return "".join(s)

truth = seq("truth.fa")
rows = [("draft", "draft.fa"), ("racon", "polished-racon.fa"), ("medaka", "polished-medaka.fa")]
print("stage\tbp\tedit_distance\tidentity_pct\tQ")
out = {}
for name, path in rows:
    s = seq(path)
    # circular plasmid: a linear consensus can start anywhere, so compare under rotation by
    # doubling the truth and asking for the best infix match. Without this a correct
    # consensus with a different start point scores as thousands of errors.
    r = edlib.align(s, truth + truth, mode="HW", task="distance")
    d = r["editDistance"]
    ident = 100.0 * (1 - d / len(truth))
    # d == 0 is the GOOD case and the first version of this line divided by d to produce
    # it, so a perfect consensus crashed the scorer. Guard first, compute second.
    q = "inf" if d == 0 else "%.1f" % (-10 * math.log10(d / len(truth)))
    print("%s\t%d\t%d\t%.4f\t%s" % (name, len(s), d, ident, q))
    out[name] = d
print("# planted: 18 substitutions + 3 deletions = 21 errors")
if not (out["racon"] < out["draft"]):
    print("FAIL racon did not improve on the draft", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
if not (out["medaka"] < out["draft"]):
    print("FAIL medaka did not improve on the draft", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
PYEOF
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "scoring failed"; exit 1; }

cat score.tsv > medaka-diag.txt
{ printf 'medaka_version\t%s\n' "$(medaka --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
  printf 'model\t%s\nmedaka_wall_s\t%s\n' "$MODEL" "$(( T1 - T0 ))"; } >> medaka-diag.txt
echo "MEDAKA OK"
